literal: Engaging in the task, may the king win and grant us release; uniting at home, we shall celebrate the evening as a feast.
translation: May the king engage in his task and win, so that we may unite at home and celebrate the evening as a feast.
modern: அரசன் தன் கடமையில் ஈடுபட்டு வெற்றி பெறட்டும்; நாம் நம் வீட்டில் ஒன்று கூடி, இந்த மாலைப் பொழுதை ஒரு விருந்தாகக் கொண்டாடுவோம்.
explanation: The hero, who is away on a royal military campaign, eagerly wishes for the king to complete his task and achieve victory quickly. He longs to return to his wife so they can be reunited. In classical love poetry, the evening is usually a time of intense sorrow for separated lovers. However, the hero anticipates that once they unite at home, they will transform this dreaded evening into a joyous feast of reunion.
